name: Pra Upper Basin (Control)
note: On the Pra mainstem, confirmed against OpenStreetMap, and ABOVE the Pra/Offin confluence -- imagery shows the channel is 40 m here and 120 m below the junction 8 km south-west. The Offin is the heavily mined tributary, so a control above the junction cannot be contaminated by Offin galamsey. This is the arrangement the alert suppression logic depends on.
